status: DRAFT - not approved by Gary, NOT wired into game code
palette: art/world/overworld/palette.hex (64 colours) + full transparency; alpha is 0 or 255 only
scale_rule: draw 1x frames scaled by an integer (2x/3x) with nearest-neighbour only; *_2x files are exact nearest copies
sheet_layout: horizontal strip; frame i rect = [i*w, 0, w, h] (rects[] lists them)
emissive_rule: emissive 'all' -> grade with grades.<g>.lit (lut_<g>_lit.png); 'none' -> grades.<g>.sprite; 'mask' -> per pixel by <name>_emissive_sheet.png. Draw order: palette swaps -> grade.
about: Heal-centre restore FX (SOUL_PLAYBOOK heal beat): party crystals set into the machine, a 1 s company-violet flash, a recalibration ping, then each creature's Warmth seeps back in ordered dither.

sequence: nurse line ends -> for k in 0..party-1: heal_slot_place at SLOTS[k], 200 ms apart (place SFX each)
flash: heal_slot_flash on filled slots + heal_screen_pulse + party_crystal_flash, 8 x 125 ms = 1000 ms
heal_recal_ping at the eye, then party_seep_back over 2000 ms (runs after the screen fades back in; can overlap the party menu)
hooks.machine_tiles: heal_machine (1x2: heal_machine_0_0 top, heal_machine_1_0 bottom); i_heal_machine 2x2 variant needs its own offsets (not measured)

party_crystal_flash.what: every party creature sprite/icon: crystal-mask pixels only (warmth/masks/<creature>/<same rel path>)
party_crystal_flash.company: draw the crystal pixels with Warmth stage 0 colours (the unswapped source ramp 3a1e60..f4e2ff)
party_crystal_flash.bright: fill crystal pixels with 'd6acff' (pixels that are 'f4e2ff' in the source stay 'f4e2ff')
party_crystal_flash.meaning: the company machine briefly re-asserts control: the light snaps back to company violet

party_seep_back.what: crystal pixels go from stage 0 back to the creature's CURRENT Warmth stage, ordered-dither, never a colour blend
party_seep_back.rule: at step s (1..8) a crystal pixel at sprite-local (x,y) shows the warm colour if BAYER[y%4][x%4] < 2*s, else stage 0. Key the pattern to sprite-local coordinates so it does not crawl when the sprite moves.
party_seep_back.stage0_creatures: stage 0 creatures: skip the seep (nothing to return to)

hooks.interiors: heal centres are interiors: they stay on the DAY grade (club_int is the only interior on the clock). ToD strips below grade them as outdoors anyway, as a worst case.
hooks.reduced_motion: replace the 125 ms alternation with one 1000 ms hold of the bright state; seep-back in 4 steps of 500 ms
hooks.photosensitivity: the flash is small (slots + crystal pixels), not full-screen; 4 Hz alternation is fine for small areas

slots.rule: fraction of FX pixels with |dLuma|>=28 vs graded background under them, per phase; pass >= 0.5

flash.rule: fraction of FX pixels with |dLuma|>=28 vs graded background under them, per phase; pass >= 0.5

screen.rule: fraction of FX pixels with |dLuma|>=28 vs graded background under them, per phase; pass >= 0.5

ping.rule: fraction of FX pixels with |dLuma|>=28 vs graded background under them, per phase; pass >= 0.5

empty.rule: fraction of FX pixels with |dLuma|>=28 vs graded background under them, per phase; pass >= 0.0
empty.note: slot_empty is a deliberate dark cover over a violet slot (low contrast by design); not held to the 50% rule

heal_slot_empty.notes: Optional: covers an unused slot (party < 6) so only filled slots glow. Static.

heal_slot_place.notes: One party crystal set into slot k: pop -> settle. Hold frame 3 until all slots are placed.

heal_slot_flash.notes: All filled slots alternate in company violet at 125 ms (4 cycles = 1 s). Same timing as the party crystal flash.

heal_screen_pulse.notes: Ring around the machine eye, in phase with heal_slot_flash.

anchor.meaning: centre on the machine eye (tile 0_0 px [32, 51]) at the end of the flash

heal_recal_ping.notes: "Recalibrated" ping when healing ends. Play the done jingle on frame 0.
